name: online.gothere/japan-travel
title: GoThere Japan Transit & Travel
description: Japan route comparison, crowd forecasts, sights, events & nearby places in 5 languages.

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Find stations, airports, bus terminals, ports, sightseeing spots and sights in Japan by name (Japanese, English, Chinese or Korean; partial match). Returns place IDs to use with get_place and find_routes, coordinates, and the URL of each place's page. Returns results[]: type (place or sight), id, kind, name, names (five languages), lat, lng, area, page (URL for people), api (URL of the details), routeEndpoint (pass it to find_routes as from or to).

q.description: Name or part of a name, up to 60 characters.

lang.description: Language of names and texts in the response. Long descriptions exist in Japanese and English only; other languages fall back to English.

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Details of one place: names in five languages, coordinates, kind, the area guide it belongs to, a short description, sights within walking distance, upcoming events nearby, related themes, lines that stop there (for stations), and the URL of its page. Returns id, kind, name, names, lat, lng, area, about (description, typical stay, fee, rainy-day and step-free notes; only for sights), station (lines, lockers, step-free access; only for stations), highlights (walkable sights and classics in the same area), eventsHere, eventsNearby, themes, page, routesToHerePage.

id.description: Place ID or sight ID returned by search_places or find_nearby (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens).

lang.description: Language of names and texts in the response. Long descriptions exist in Japanese and English only; other languages fall back to English.

tools.name: find_routes
tools.description: Compare ways to travel between two places in Japan, combining trains, subways, buses, flights, ferries, walking and (optionally) taxi or bicycle. Returns several itineraries with duration, fare, transfers, walking time and expected crowding, plus the URL of the result page. Times and fares are estimates computed from typical travel times and service intervals, not from timetables. Returns page (the same search on the site, with map), query (resolved date and time in Japan time), from, to, itineraries[]: depart, arrive, durationMinutes, fareYen (whole party), fareAdultYen, transfers, walkMinutes, crowdMax (1 = empty to 5 = very crowded), ease (0 to 100), tags (recommended, fastest, cheapest, easiest, calmest), advice[], legs[] (mode, line, from, to, depart, arrive, fareYen, crowdLevel). empty is set when nothing was found.

from.description: Origin. A place ID (for example "tokyo", "kyoto", "spot-sensoji"; find IDs with search_places), or a map point written as "@lat,lng,label" (for example "@35.7148,139.7967,Senso-ji").

to.description: Destination. A place ID (for example "tokyo", "kyoto", "spot-sensoji"; find IDs with search_places), or a map point written as "@lat,lng,label" (for example "@35.7148,139.7967,Senso-ji").

d.description: Date in Japan time, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit both d and t to search from now. With d only, the search starts at 09:00.

m.description: Whether d/t is the departure time or the latest arrival time.

c.description: Number of children aged 6 to 11 (child fare).

p.description: Traveler situation, comma-separated. Any of: luggage, stroller, kids, wheelchair, senior, simple, jrpass. (luggage = large suitcases, stroller = with a baby stroller, kids = with children, wheelchair = step-free routes, senior = avoid long walks, simple = fewer and easier transfers, jrpass = holds a Japan Rail Pass.)

x.description: Transport to exclude, comma-separated. Any of: shinkansen, limited, flight, bus, hbus, ferry. (limited = limited express trains, hbus = highway buses.)

taxi.description: Set to 1 to include taxi options.

bike.description: Set to 1 to include bicycle options.

w.description: Longest acceptable single walk, in minutes.

lang.description: Language of names and texts in the response. Long descriptions exist in Japanese and English only; other languages fall back to English.

tools.name: find_nearby
tools.description: Stations, sights and this week's events within walking distance of a place or a coordinate in Japan, nearest first, with estimated walking minutes. Give either place (a place ID) or lat and lng. Coordinates are used only to compute distances and are not stored. Returns origin, stations[] (with walkMinutes), sights[] (with walkMinutes, description, fee, rainy-day and step-free notes, routeEndpoint), events[] (this week, within 5 km), page.

place.description: Place ID to search around (use this instead of lat/lng when the user names a station or spot).

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84), within Japan. Three decimal places are enough.

limit.description: Maximum number of sights (stations and events are capped at 5 each).

lang.description: Language of names and texts in the response. Long descriptions exist in Japanese and English only; other languages fall back to English.

tools.name: find_events
tools.description: Festivals, fireworks, illuminations, seasonal events and similar in Japan whose dates were confirmed on official announcements. Filter by date range, region and kind. Each event has its dates, venue, nearest place ID and the official URL. Returns from, to, total, events[]: id, name, kind, start, end, time, venue, region, nearestPlace (id usable as a find_routes destination), description, caution, officialUrl, fee (free, paid or part), dateSource (official or press), routesPage; and page (the event list on the site).

from.description: First day (Japan time, YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

to.description: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 30 days after from. The range may span at most 366 days.

lang.description: Language of names and texts in the response. Long descriptions exist in Japanese and English only; other languages fall back to English.
